name: Ransom
tagline: Bid cards for a face-up Lot and a hostage only the Warden has seen.
core_loop: Secretly commit one card as an opening bid, then optionally raise in rotating order; the top bid vaults the Lot and the hidden Hostage while every loser's bid becomes the next Lot.
win_condition: Most points when the draw pile and all hands are empty; vaulted cards of your secret Warrant suit score their rank, all others score 2.
